## What this chapter covers

This chapter covers **publish-layer maintenance** after an analytical package has already passed its Stata review, approval and publication controls.

Typical tasks include:

- updating a narrative briefing page to use a newly published analytical package;
- maintaining ordinary Quarto content pages;
- updating navigation and listings;
- checking Downloads integration; and
- confirming that public pages point only to the website mirror or other approved public resources.

Analytical values should not be recalculated or manually corrected in Quarto. If an analytical product is wrong, return to the relevant Stata workflow.

Use [Update an existing briefing](update-briefing.qmd) for the package-specific briefing update process.
